query:
SELECT 
  pi.id,
  pi.imageType, 
  SUBSTRING(pi.imageUrl, -40) as imageFile,
  SUBSTRING(pi.caption, 1, 50) as captionPreview,
  SUBSTRING(p.coverImageUrl, -40) as coverFile
FROM projectImages pi
JOIN projects p ON pi.projectId = p.id
WHERE p.slug = 'red-bull-jukebox'
ORDER BY pi.imageType;
